title: Change one company name to uppercase
description:
Change one of the it_companies names to uppercase (IBM excluded!).

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as uppercase_company(companies, index), returning a new list with the item at index converted to uppercase using str.upper().
hints: Strings have a method that returns an uppercase copy of themselves.
Copy the list first, then replace just the one item at the given index.
expected_behavior: Returns a new list with the item at the given index uppercased.
solution:
def uppercase_company(companies, index):
    updated = companies.copy()
    updated[index] = updated[index].upper()
    return updated
explanation: str.upper() returns an uppercase copy of a string; combined with index assignment on a copy of the list, only the chosen company's name changes.
